TextBlock.Text: THEATRE Timor Sea, north-west of Darwin
DATE 15 November 2028 · 2130 local
SIDE Royal Australian Navy
WINDOW 60 min, closes at 90
F-22A Raptor. Photo: F-22_Raptor.JPG : Master Sgt. Andy Dunaway · Public domain · cropped
"Readiness is critical to an effective deterrence, not only in Air Force, but across all domains."
- Air Vice-Marshal Harvey Reynolds, Deputy Chief of Air Force, RAAF

TIMOR SEA, 2130. Wedgetail 02 has a raid out of the north-west: four H-6K and two J-16, three hundred and forty miles from Darwin and closing at four hundred and forty knots. Signals say YJ-12. The target is the anchorage, where the ships for the Common Sea convoy are forming.

Taipan 11 to 14, No. 75 Squadron F-35As with AIM-260, are on CAP a hundred and forty miles out; Raptor 31 and 32, USAF F-22s out of Tindal, are behind them. Dragon 41, a KC-30A, is south of the CAP. The bombers' own radar will not give them a track on the anchorage until they are inside two hundred miles, and that is the line.
Shoot down at least three of the four before any of them reaches it. Darwin-Denpasar 112 is on her normal track and has been told nothing; she will cross the raid's path. Identify before you fire.
Wing Commander Daniel Ward, Air Component, RAAF Tindal
COMMANDER'S INTENT

Four bombers and two escorts, and the bombers are carrying YJ-12 for the ships at Darwin, which is everything we have assembled for the Common Sea convoy. A YJ-12 has two hundred and seventy miles in it; they will want to be a lot closer than that before they trust a track. Kill the bombers before they get there and the escorts if they let you. There is an airliner on the Denpasar track in the middle of it, and she is the one thing out there you may not shoot.
• Shoot down three of the four bombers before they reach launch range
• Shoot down both J-16s
• Lose no fighter
• Lose no ship at Darwin
• Harm no civil aircraft

Four RAAF F-35A, two USAF F-22, an E-7A Wedgetail and a KC-30A, out of Tindal and Darwin; two merchants at the Darwin anchorage. Opposing: four H-6K with YJ-12 and two J-16. Neutral: an airliner on the Darwin-Denpasar track.

The planned window is 60 minutes. At that minute Command signals that you are behind schedule and holds the line for about 30 minutes more; the operation is closed at 90 minutes and the main task will be recorded as failed.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT
All designated neutral contacts are protected. A protected neutral loss cancels the operation. Identify before you shoot.
